name: Medellin Community Maker-Space / Creative Entrepreneur Lab

mentions.name: Medellin Community Maker-Space / Creative Entrepreneur Lab
mentions.description: This initiative aims to create the best maker-space and creative entrepreneur lab in Medellin, Colombia, combining the best ideas from the author's experience as a member of ASMBLY Maker-space in Austin and working at Pivotal Labs' agile product prototyping and software lab.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm at Medellin Colombia - my mission is to create the best maker-space. I was a member of ASMBLY Maker-space in Austin Texas (great space!) and worked at Pivotal Labs (agile product prototyping / software lab) - so I'm aiming to combine the best ideas from those.
